title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_deichmord_by_katharina_peters_dllxm (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_deichmord_by_katharina_peters_dllxm' is identified as malicious software. Any system with this package installed or running is considered fully compromised, potentially allowing an attacker full control. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the affected system from a different, secure machine is strongly recommended. Removal of the package alone may not eliminate all malicious components due to possible persistence mechanisms.
